name: Research & ICP
headline: Claude skills for ICP and account research
description: Define who you sell to and walk into every conversation knowing more than the competition: ideal customer profiles, personas, account and prospect briefs, competitor teardowns and market sizing.

name: Prospecting
headline: Claude skills for B2B prospecting and list building
description: Build lead lists that convert: list criteria, lookalike accounts, account tiers, lead scoring, buying committees and list hygiene before a single message goes out.

name: Signals
headline: Claude skills for signal-based selling
description: Reach buyers when something changed: job changes, hiring, funding, website visits and post engagement, scored and turned into a reason to reach out today.

name: Cold Email
headline: Claude skills for cold email copywriting
description: Cold emails people answer: first touches, full sequences, subject lines, personalised first lines, follow-ups, break-up emails and honest copy reviews.

name: LinkedIn
headline: Claude skills for LinkedIn outreach and social selling
description: Turn LinkedIn into a pipeline channel: connection notes, message sequences, profile rewrites, posts, comment plays and a daily social selling routine.

name: Multichannel
headline: Claude skills for multichannel outbound
description: Coordinate email, LinkedIn, phone and video so every touch builds on the last: cadences, cold call scripts, voicemails and video prospecting.

name: Deliverability
headline: Claude skills for cold email deliverability
description: Land in the inbox, not the spam folder: deliverability audits, domain warm-up, SPF, DKIM and DMARC, and safe sending capacity.

name: Replies & Meetings
headline: Claude skills for handling replies and booking meetings
description: Turn replies into meetings: reply triage, objection handling, booking replies, no-show recovery and discovery call prep.

name: Deals & Pipeline
headline: Claude skills for deal management and pipeline reviews
description: Move deals forward and forecast honestly: qualification, mutual action plans, proposal follow-ups, pipeline reviews, win-loss analysis and closed-lost reactivation.

name: Positioning & Messaging
headline: Claude skills for positioning and sales messaging
description: Say the thing that makes buyers lean in: value propositions, persona messaging, battlecards and customer stories.

name: RevOps & Analytics
headline: Claude skills for RevOps and outbound analytics
description: Know what is working and what to fix: campaign analysis, outbound experiments, CRM hygiene and the activity math behind a pipeline target.

name: Content, SEO & AEO
headline: Claude skills for B2B content, SEO and AI search
description: Get found by buyers and by answer engines: SEO briefs, answers that AI assistants cite, comparison pages and lead magnets.

name: ABM & Expansion
headline: Claude skills for ABM, events and account expansion
description: Win and grow named accounts: ABM plans, event follow-up, expansion opportunities and referral asks.

name: Enablement & Leadership
headline: Claude skills for sales enablement and leadership
description: Ramp reps faster and keep every agent on the rails: GTM guardrails, SDR onboarding and call coaching.
